scope: No training, tuning, checkpoint selection, split alteration or overwrite of historical evidence.

prediction_analysis.population: All 389 fixed final images; report all UAV and native area<=16 separately
prediction_analysis.matching: Original COCO evaluator, maxDets300, unchanged predictions and score ordering. Verify exact original metrics first. Paired GT outcomes from area-all matching, then stratify matched GT by native area; separately retain original area-specific recall validation.
outputs: TP and unmatched retained detections by fixed confidence bins [0.001,0.01,0.1,0.25,0.5,1.000001]

all-size unmatched detection categories: duplicate (same-class IoU>=threshold), localization (same-class IoU>=0.1), class-confusion (other-class IoU>=threshold), background; ordered diagnostic categories, not causal attribution
prediction_analysis.limits: Saved predictions are post-NMS. No claim to isolate NMS removal, geometric precision or causal mechanism. No significance-based outcome selection.

group_audit.inputs: Existing pixel-unique catalog, strict/broad perceptual edge lists, retained ORB/RANSAC edges and frozen split
group_audit.checks: Reconstruct original component mappings and confirm zero recorded-edge split crossings. Reconstruct strict and broad group counts. Compute stricter retained-geometric-edge sensitivity using inliers>=24, ratio>=0.7, minimum span>=0.15, scale[0.75,1.33], angle<=20; do not rerun matching or change splits.
group_audit.visual_sample: Twelve existing geometric edges: four smallest inlier counts, four smallest minimum spans excluding already selected, four evenly spaced from remaining edge indices. Show representative grayscale images and affine alignment; record observations as qualitative checks, not estimated precision or scene identity.
group_audit.group_cap: Report counts and images in groups above existing cap187; relate to target heldout size, but do not invent undocumented original optimization rationale.

cost.checkpoints: Same six frozen grouped epoch50 EMA weights as prediction comparison; SHA256 checked before and after
cost.inputs: 32 lowest-numeric-ID grouped training images; fixed independently of predictions
cost.settings: RTX4060Ti, batch1, FP32, unfused, inference_mode, 4 Torch CPU threads, deterministic algorithms, cudnn benchmark off; original image_tensor, decoder and NMS conf0.001/IoU0.7/maxDets300/nc2
cost.order: Seed17 A/H; seed29 H/A; seed43 A/H. 20 complete-pipeline warmups per checkpoint then 3 blocks of64 iterations. No concurrent training or CPU analysis during timing.
cost.timing: CUDA-synchronized wall time separately for raw forward, decode, NMS including clone, and end-to-end including image loading/preprocessing/transfer/forward/decode/NMS/rescale/CPU copy. Preserve all samples; mean of three checkpoint medians plus per-seed paired changes.
cost.memory: After timing delete all32 resident inputs and staged outputs; keep one input, warm10 iterations, clear unused cache, measure3 single-input forward+decode+NMS peaks; includes model/input/grid caches, excludes host/driver memory. Report median of3 per checkpoint then mean acrossseeds.
cost.hardware: Record driver, GPU state and process snapshot; desktop WDDM background activity is not fully controlled. No clock changes or termination of user processes.
cost.failure: Stop on hash mismatch, unexpected training, OOM or incomplete measurement; preserve partial logs and report. No repeated runs to obtain preferred latency.
